description: Land Acquisition - Watareka, Mawathagama D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific plots of land being acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes descriptions of land names, types, claimants, original claimants, and extents, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related matters.
